title: fix(app-shell,i18n): a dashboard or report route's breadcrumb drops its type crumb (objectui#12273)
body:
Fixes #12273
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Applies the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2768 (comment 6118501670) to the two remaining route types, as triage `6133338003` directs (the card's option A): on a dashboard or report route the trail after the app pill is the item alone, and both type-crumb keys are retired from the ten packs. Precedent: objectui#12198 / PR objectui#12247 (the Pages crumb). Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 1 dev run, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`.

## What changed

- **The crumbs.** `AppHeader`'s `extraSegments` no longer pushes `{ label: t('console.breadcrumb.dashboards'), href: baseHref }` in the `routeType === 'dashboard'` branch, nor the `console.breadcrumb.reports` twin in the `routeType === 'report'` branch. On `/apps/APP/dashboard/NAME` the trail was app › Dashboards › dashboard; on `/apps/APP/report/NAME`, app › Reports › report. Each type crumb named a metadata type and linked only to the app's base, which the pill already opens. The trail now goes from the pill straight to the item, as a page's does. Nothing else in `AppHeader.tsx` moves: page, system and object branches are untouched.
- **The keys.** Each key had exactly one reader, that push. It is retired from all ten packs (`en`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `ru`, `ar`). In `zh` the comment recording the 报表 term ruling sat on the `reports` key and leaves with it (see Acceptance notes).
- **The pin.** New `AppHeader.dashboardReportCrumb-12273.test.tsx` renders the real `AppHeader` under a real `I18nProvider`, so it reads the published packs, in `en` and `zh`. It pins:
  - a dashboard route: the crumbs after the pill are exactly `['Ops Board']`;
  - a report route: exactly `['Sales Summary']` (the report trail was read from code on the card; it is rendered here);
  - the other route types keep their segments: a page is `['Welcome']`, an object list `['Accounts']` linked to `/apps/crm/account`, a record `['Accounts', '#acc1']`;
  - CONTROL: a `system/settings` route still draws its pack type crumb (`['System', 'Settings']`, `['系统', '设置']`), so the absence on the dashboard and report routes is a reading, not a harness blind to pack crumbs.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/12273-dashboard-report-crumb.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` `minor` with a BREAKING note naming both keys and saying they have no replacement; `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.

## Published surface

The narrowing, for the at-tier contract review. Two pack keys of `@object-ui/i18n` are removed from all ten published packs, with no replacement:

- `console.breadcrumb.dashboards`
- `console.breadcrumb.reports`

Nothing is added, no key is renamed, and no accepted input widens. A host that looked either key up through the published packs now gets the key string back.

## Reader measurement (re-measured over the whole tree)

`git grep -n -F` on `1fb1ced`, every path (tests, docs, `apps/**`, `content/**`, `skills/**` included):

- `console.breadcrumb.dashboards`: 1 file, `AppHeader.tsx`.
- `console.breadcrumb.reports`: `AppHeader.tsx`, plus 2 lines of `packages/i18n/CHANGELOG.md` (the release history of the 报表 ruling; a published CHANGELOG is historical record and is not edited).
- Control `console.breadcrumb.marketplace`: 8 files, of which 2 are not CHANGELOGs (`AppHeader.tsx` and `AppHeader.marketplaceBreadcrumb-10900.test.tsx`). The instrument sees a test reader when one exists.
- No dynamic `console.breadcrumb.` head exists (no template-literal or bracket read of the namespace).
- Sibling objectstack checkout at `df7a1379`: zero hits for both keys, and also zero for `console.breadcrumb.marketplace` and `console.breadcrumb.system`. That tree reads no `console.breadcrumb.*` key at all, so the control cannot ring there; whether a host outside these two repos reads the keys stays unmeasured, the same gap the Pages retirement accepted.

## Proof the pin can fail

Each mutation landed through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (anchor hit verified 1 to 0, blob changed), and was restored with blob == HEAD (`2fc695ce6437`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. `AppHeader` is imported by relative path, so the run reads `src`, no build in between.

- Planting the `console.breadcrumb.dashboards` push back into the dashboard branch: 2 failed / 7 passed. Both dashboard cases (`en`, `zh`) received `["console.breadcrumb.dashboards", "Ops Board"]`: the key is gone from every pack, so the planted crumb renders its key string.
- Planting the `console.breadcrumb.reports` push back into the report branch: 2 failed / 7 passed, both report cases receiving `["console.breadcrumb.reports", "Sales Summary"]`.
- The first attempt at the dashboard leg was a no-op that the tool refused before any test ran: its replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count could not drop. Re-anchored and re-run as above.

## Acceptance notes

- **The zh 报表 ruling comment.** `zh.ts` carried, on `console.breadcrumb.reports`, the comment recording the maintainer's ruling that this key reads 报表, not 报告. The key is retired, so the comment leaves with it. The other keys that name the same feature (`console.commandPalette.reports`, `console.nav.navReport`, `search.badgeReport`) already read 报表 and are untouched, and the ruling's release note stays in `packages/i18n/CHANGELOG.md`.
- **No pack-side retirement pin, mirroring PR objectui#12247.** That PR added none for `console.breadcrumb.pages`. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only and wired into no workflow (its own header says so), so a key re-added to the packs with no reader would go unflagged by CI. A re-added reader goes red in this pin, and in `check:i18n-keys` while the key is absent.
- **A bare `/apps/APP/dashboard` or `/apps/APP/report`.** No route serves it (`AppContent` declares only `dashboard/:dashboardName` and `report/:reportName`). On it the header used to draw the lone type crumb, and now draws nothing after the pill. Read from code, not rendered.
- The compact mobile title reads the trail's last segment, still the item on both routes.
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` needs a built console bundle and answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally: NOT MEASURED here, left to CI. The diff only shrinks the packs.

## Gates (local, all at `12863df`)

- Build of the `@object-ui/app-shell` dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, under the verify lock): 28 of 28 tasks, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: exit 0, both echo `type-check: Done`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` in app-shell lists the new test file.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/ packages/i18n/`: 148 files passed, 1790 tests passed, 13 skipped. The 15 test files outside `layout/` that name `AppHeader` (app-shell and `apps/console`): 15 passed, 118 tests. The whole suite is CI's.
- eslint on the 12 touched source files (from each package directory, as its `lint` script runs): `--format json` reports 12 files, 0 errors, 0 ignored. The 22 warnings are `no-explicit-any` in `AppHeader.tsx`, 22 at base too. The new test file has none. Type-aware linting is not enabled in `eslint.config.js` (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (prints "2 removed — those are all-locales-key-parity's"), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.
